weight_handling.admission_weight_static: Standardized static baseline capturing habitus at admission (col 2 of static array).
weight_handling.dynamic_weight: Hourly dynamic time series (feature index 35 of dynamic array).
weight_handling.dual_representation_note: Weight measured at 00:00 is present in both static descriptor and dynamic Hour 0. In tabular feature engineering (XGBoost), extract net delta (W_last - W_adm) and volatility (W_max - W_min) rather than redundant static duplications to prevent multicollinearity.

mechvent_handling.interpretation: Absent records denote unrecorded status, not confirmed non-ventilation. MIMIC-II logs MechVent as procedural events (100% of records are 1.0).
mechvent_handling.hourly_discretization: Preserves explicit observations only (1.0 with mask 1.0). Unrecorded hours are 0.0 with mask 0.0.
mechvent_handling.no_forward_fill_to_discharge: MechVent is exempted from forward-fill to avoid assuming persistent ventilation without documentation.
mechvent_handling.patient_level_indicator: MechVent_ever_recorded is added to static features (1.0 if ever recorded in observation window, 0.0 otherwise).

imputation_method_b.description: Historical Forward-Fill (LOCF) with Training-Set Population Median for Leading Missing Values.
imputation_method_b.temporal_direction: Strictly forward in time (hours 0 -> 47). Zero backward-filling from future observations.

outcome_provenance.set_a: Development dataset released with official outcomes in 2012.
outcome_provenance.sets_b_and_c: Official test partitions released post-challenge by PhysioNet as academic benchmark keys.
outcome_provenance.isolation_policy: Set B and Set C outcomes are completely isolated from model development and used exclusively for final out-of-sample evaluation.
